caption:
She freezes as the faceless crowd erupts.
Seedance 2.5 shot this whole thing in one take.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. Aspect ratio 4:3 landscape. Ultra-realistic cinematic live-action, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field in the opening close-up, soft flat overcast daylight, muted desaturated palette of cream-white, beige and weathered brick red with the woman as the only black element, fine film grain. Camera feel: ONE continuous unbroken take on a smooth stabilized dolly/crane that steadily pulls back and slowly rises, no cuts. Pacing: slow, calm and hypnotic for 19 seconds, then sudden rhythmic, perfectly synchronized crowd movement on a steady beat.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WOMAN: early 20s East Asian woman, fair smooth skin, soft dark-brown eyes, natural rosy lips, calm expressionless face; dark-brown chin-length blunt bob with wispy curtain bangs, hair loose; small silver stud earring; loose black knit mock-turtleneck sweater with long sleeves and black straight trousers. She is the only person in black and the only visible face in the frame.
- THE CROWD: about 300 adult men of identical build packed shoulder to shoulder in staggered rows; each head and face completely wrapped in smooth seamless cream-white fabric like a featureless cloth hood (no eyes, no mouth, only the rounded shape of head and nose); identical untucked cream-white short-sleeve linen button-up shirts, loose beige chino trousers, tan suede shoes; arms hanging straight down at their sides.

LOCATION: a huge outdoor amphitheater of weathered red-brick terraced steps; the crowd stands on the steps rising away from the camera. Behind and above them a massive red-brick semicircular arch (half-dome vault) with a deep dark shadowed recess at its centre, flanked by tall plain brick walls; pale white-grey overcast sky. In the foreground a flat red-brick paved plaza at the foot of the steps, revealed only at the very end.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:30.1) — one continuous take, no cuts:
00:00.0-00:00.5 — Close-up at eye level of the woman's face and shoulders, centered, looking straight into the lens; masked men soft-focus behind her. She slowly exhales a soft cloud of white smoke from her lips that drifts down across her chin and chest (no cigarette visible in frame).
00:00.5-00:02.5 — She lowers her eyes, turns her head and rotates her whole body away until her back is to the camera, the bob swinging slightly.
00:02.5-00:08.0 — Seen from behind, she walks slowly away from the camera up the brick steps into the motionless crowd; the camera follows behind, then begins a slow pull-back so she shrinks in frame. The masked men do not react at all.
00:08.0-00:12.0 — She turns sideways and squeezes between two rows of masked men, shoulders brushing their shirts, her body partly hidden behind their wrapped heads; the camera keeps pulling back and gently rising, more rows of cloth-wrapped heads fill the frame, the top of the brick arch appears at the top edge.
00:12.0-00:14.0 — She steps into an open spot in the exact centre of the crowd, about six rows deep, and turns around to face the camera.
00:14.0-00:19.0 — Wide frontal shot from slightly above: she stands completely still, arms at her sides, expressionless, staring into the lens; the entire crowd is frozen; the camera keeps an almost imperceptible pull-back. MUST SHOW: rows of identical faceless cloth-wrapped heads filling the frame, her bare face and black sweater the only contrast, centered.
00:19.0-00:30.1 — Suddenly the entire crowd moves in perfect synchronization while she stays perfectly still: on a steady beat about every 1.5 seconds every man clutches his stomach with both hands, jerks his shoulders and snaps forward at the waist until the wrapped heads point at the ground (bodies folded at 90 degrees, a sea of rounded cream backs and heads around her), then snaps back upright with heads cocked sharply to one side, then folds again. Fully folded at 00:19.5, 00:21.0, 00:23.0, 00:25.0 and 00:28.0. Each fold uncovers the dark recess of the brick arch directly behind her. Motion blur on the fast moves, a slight ripple of timing through the rows. The camera continues a smooth pull-back and rise from medium-wide to extreme wide, revealing the full half-dome arch, the brick walls on both sides, the bottom steps and the empty brick plaza in the foreground by 00:29.5. MUST SHOW: the woman as a motionless black figure in the exact centre while hundreds of faceless men fold and snap upright around her; the giant brick arch behind.

SOUND: soft wind, faint fabric rustle, her single slow exhale, quiet footsteps on brick; near silence while everyone is frozen; at 00:19.0 a deep, slow, hypnotic percussive instrumental beat kicks in, each fold landing on a heavy drum hit with a sharp synchronized whoosh of hundreds of shirts. No dialogue, no text on screen.
prompt_short: 4:3 photoreal one-take. Woman with dark bob, black turtleneck exhales smoke, walks into a crowd of men with faceless cream cloth-wrapped heads on brick steps, turns, stands still; crowd folds forward in sync on a beat as camera pulls back to a giant brick arch. Eerie.
